paper_title: RedWhale An Adapted Korean LLM Through Efficient Continual Pretraining
caption: : Model complexity analysis.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the relationship between vocabulary size and scaled complexity ratios for two metrics—Input Complexity and Embedding Complexity—as part of a model complexity analysis. The x-axis, labeled "Vocab Size," uses a linear scale ranging from 10,000 to 40,000, with tick marks at regular intervals of 5,000. The y-axis, labeled "Scaled Ratio," is also linear and spans from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The plot features two lines: the "Input Complexity" is represented by a blue line with solid circular markers, starting at a scaled ratio of 1.0 when the vocab size is 10,000 and decreasing monotonically to 0.0 at 40,000. The "Embedding Complexity" is shown as a teal line with solid circular markers, beginning at 0.0 at a vocab size of 10,000 and increasing monotonically to 1.0 at 40,000. The two lines intersect near a vocab size of 20,000, where both have a scaled ratio of approximately 0.35.
